rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an adult or adults.

example.english: A child should not eavesdrop on a grown-up talking.
example.traditional: 細路仔唔好偷聽大人講嘢。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 m4 hou2 tau1 teng1 daai6 jan4 gong2 je5

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing legal age, adulthood, or an official age category.

example.english: You only count as a grown-up once you are eighteen.
example.traditional: 年滿十八歲先算成年人。
example.jyutping: nin4 mun5 sap6 baat3 seoi3 sin1 syun3 sing4 nin4 jan4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things intended for or associated with adults, especially in compounds such as 成人用品.

example.english: These grown-up products aren't suitable for children.
example.traditional: 呢啲成人用品唔啱細路用。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sing4 jan4 jung6 ban2 m4 ngaam1 sai3 lou6 jung6

rows.note: Use this when grown-up means having a mature outlook, judgment, or way of thinking rather than simply being an adult.

example.english: They have a grown-up way of thinking and don't panic when problems arise.
example.traditional: 佢諗嘢好成熟，遇到問題都唔會亂咁嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 nam2 je5 hou2 sing4 suk6 jyu6 dou3 man6 tai4 dou1 m4 wui5 lyun6 gam3 lai4
